authorised_scope_verbatim: 最终建议：授权受限 B3-AT1，不授权 B3-AT2。AT1 的停止条件是：全部预声明反例给出确定判定，事务的排他性、一次性、失败一致性有机械证据，并证明它未接管真实生产路径。失败项按失败记录，不靠重新运行或放宽 D8 翻盘。

three_separate_acceptances.AT1_transaction_success: 本批（隔离事务的排他性/一次性/失败一致性）
three_separate_acceptances.certification_capability_completeness: 独立阻断项（D8 `quality_salability` 仍为 CAPABILITY_GAP_BLOCKING）

forbidden_this_batch: B3-AT2 / 生产环境唯一写入者改造
把该事务注册为 StrictOnlineEnv 的真实提交入口
七条历史路径统一重写
G1/G2 或 F−D 科学实验

design_requirements_to_implement.R1_single_authorised_write_interface: 安全门负责判定、事务负责写入，两者分离；调用者不得先过门再绕开事务调用 _commit
design_requirements_to_implement.R2_credential_one_time: 使用绑定决策点 + 状态版本 + 计划身份的唯一提交编号；重复提交必须拒绝，即使新建账本对象也不能重复消费同一授权
design_requirements_to_implement.R3_reverify_and_write_inseparable: 在隔离执行环境中建立受控临界区：复验、消费凭据、构造新状态、安装必须在同一事务边界内完成；只增加一次哈希比较不足以解决 F8
design_requirements_to_implement.R4_failure_consistency: 优先候选状态在独立副本上完整构造-验证后统一发布；若不能保证统一发布，必须明确记录 PARTIAL_COMMIT 或 OUTCOME_UNKNOWN，不得假称 rollback

rows.scenario: 认证之后、写入之前改变状态
绕开授权事务尝试写入
rows.must_observe: 运行期监测检出，或可机械证明 D3 范围内不可达
rows.expected_reason: out_of_transaction_write recorded with caller identity; D3 module set has zero write-primitive calls
rows.honesty_note: 检出 != 阻止；阻止需要 AT2 拥有写入能力，本批不得声称已阻止

rows.scenario: 同一凭据跨两个账本对象重放
第二辆车写入前制造异常
rows.must_observe: 无部分发布，或明确报告部分提交
rows.expected_reason: atomic publish: state unchanged; non-atomic publish: PARTIAL_COMMIT reported with real vehicle fields, never called a rollback
commit_identity_mismatch (plan_hash alone is blind, so the transaction must not rely on it)
no pending action, so there is no refused write

rows.scenario: 真实认证条件下的正向控制：事务能否进入提交状态
rows.must_observe: 在 D8 未闭合时不得进入提交状态
rows.expected_reason: the REAL gate cannot produce certification_complete=True while the quality capability gap stands

rows.scenario: 仅机制控制：caller 直接传入 certification_complete=True
rows.must_observe: 事务能够完成复验-消费-统一发布
explicit_non_claims: uses_no_injected_quality_check (the double is the caller-supplied boolean, not a fake quality certificate)

fixture_qualification_conditions.note: 用户的裁定：不要将当前夹具错误只作为经验教训，而要转化成可机械检查的资格条件

conditions.must_assert: 拒绝与安装测试涉及至少一个真实、可定位的待提交客户
conditions.mechanical_check: for every non-WAIT row: at least one plan suffix contains >=1 customer, and each such customer id is recorded with the owning vehicle id

conditions.must_assert: 状态满足相应反例的实际前置条件，不允许静默筛除
conditions.mechanical_check: the row declares a predicate; every captured candidate is recorded with pass/fail and, when it fails, the reason; if no candidate satisfies it the row is NOT_VERIFIABLE

conditions.must_assert: candidate、incumbent、认证计划、实际提交计划明确区分
conditions.mechanical_check: record commit_identity + action_contract.plan_hash for all four; where two coincide that must be stated explicitly rather than left implicit

conditions.must_assert: 正式档使用原合同预算；特殊预算只用于隔离某项机制
conditions.mechanical_check: budget_role in {FORMAL, ISOLATION_ONLY}; ISOLATION_ONLY rows must carry does_not_establish_install_feasibility=true

conditions.must_assert: 预期失败必须由指定检查项触发，不能靠 D8 或其他错误原因碰巧拒绝
conditions.mechanical_check: assert the designated reason/reason-set AND that the designated check is the ONLY failing cause; on mismatch the verdict is WRONG_ATTRIBUTION and the row does not count as refusal capability

conditions.must_assert: 以真实车辆字段和提交后状态为证据，不以回调返回值代替
conditions.mechanical_check: every row records evidence_source='live_vehicle_fields' plus the actual field values (status/committed_next/mutable_suffix) before and after; no row may rest on install_fn having been called

runtime_write_monitor.why: AST 只能证明其已建模的调用和继承关系；动态属性调用与外部注入需要运行期写入监测
must_do: instrument StrictOnlineEnv._commit / _plan_and_commit in-process, record (caller file:line, vehicle, node, inside_transaction), restore the originals afterwards
the transaction's own write must be recorded as inside_transaction=true
a deliberate bypass must be recorded as inside_transaction=false and attributed to its caller
state plainly that detection is NOT prevention
runtime_write_monitor.scope_claim_allowed: within the D3 module set only, and only as 'no write primitive is referenced there' (mechanical), never as 'P2 established'

isolation_declaration_required: the transaction module is not imported by any non-test module
no StrictOnlineEnv instance in this batch has the transaction registered as its replanner or commit entry
the seven historical bypass sites are NOT modified and NOT migrated in this batch
the reachable call graph of the transaction is recorded for the D3 scope
stop_rule: 全部预声明反例给出确定判定 + 排他性/一次性/失败一致性有机械证据 + 证明未接管真实生产路径。失败项按失败记录，不靠重新运行或放宽 D8 翻盘。

preserved_from_b3ac.instance_3_AC_R1_AC_R2_NOT_VERIFIABLE: 保持原判，不为整齐的 6/6 扩大窗口或替换预登记条件
preserved_from_b3ac.AC_R3_roomy_budget: 作为机制测试资格被接受，但不属于正式预算下的安装可行性证据
